title: Magic Duck on Enchanted Lake
description: A bright yellow duck wearing a wizard hat and glowing with purple magic energy sails a colorful ornate boat across a calm lake. In the background, a fantastical mountain landscape features ancient cliffside buildings covered in pink flowers beneath a starry twilight sky with glowing celestial trails.
prompt: A cheerful yellow duck wearing a purple wizard hat sails an ornate wooden boat with a large colorful sail across a serene lake. The duck is surrounded by glowing purple magical energy. Behind it rises a majestic mountain range with ancient buildings and temples built into the cliffs, covered in vibrant pink flowers. The sky is a dreamy twilight with stars, comets, and a crescent moon, in a vibrant whimsical fantasy style.
